column1: # web/e2e/areas.tsv — which feature spec a changed source path makes necessary.
# WHAT THIS IS FOR. The `e2e-builder`/`e2e-core` preflight gates run the whole
# feature family on a default run. A `--for-diff <base-ref>` run narrows them to
# the specs this file maps, so a release pays for the areas it touched instead of
# the whole suite (measured 2026-11-10: the family costs ~570s, 21% of a release
# run). This file is DATA, not code: the matcher is
# (the `speccounts` gate) so a spec that arrives without a row cannot silently
# fall out of the narrowed set.
# FORMAT. TAB separated, one row per line:
# * `spec-glob` is matched against the spec's BASENAME (`builder-save-failure.spec.ts`).
#   A `*` spec-glob marks a GLOBAL area: any changed path matching it selects the
#   WHOLE family, because it is shared by specs this file cannot enumerate.
# * `area-glob` is matched against the changed path as git reports it, i.e. from
# * Blank lines and `#` lines are ignored.
# THE RULES THAT MAKE NARROWING SAFE (implemented in `e2e-scope.mjs`, asserted by
#   1. A change to a spec file selects that spec.
#   2. A change to any source path the spec NAMES (`src/...` inside its own
#      text — the import it drives) selects that spec. This is derived, not
#      typed here, so a shared helper the spec imports cannot be missed by a row.
#   3. A change to a path matched by a row's area globs selects that row's spec.
#   4. ANY OTHER changed path under `web/` selects the WHOLE family. A change
#      nothing in this file claims might still reach any spec, so it is never
#   5. A feature spec with NO row here selects the WHOLE family (the family's
#      coverage is not knowable, so it is not narrowed).
#      file, and every non-spec file under `web/e2e/` (the shared helpers) select
# So the file can only ever make a run SMALLER when a change is positively
# attributed. Getting a row wrong costs coverage of one area; leaving a path
# unclaimed costs the whole family's run time, never coverage.
# THE BLIND SPOT, NAMED. A narrowed run does not exercise a spec whose area the
# diff did not touch, and the printed decision line says so (`e2e-core: 41/76
# specs`) — it is never reported as the full family. `PREFLIGHT_E2E=full` forces
# every spec on any run, and that is the run a release card must quote as full.
# ---- GLOBAL: shared by the whole family, so any change selects all of it ----
# The guide pages' fold/wrap/lede-once guards (card t_b5ea9103). Claimed here so a change to
# the guides' content or to GuideArticle narrows to the spec that reads it; web/src/components/
# Markdown.ts is deliberately NOT claimed — the chat and feedback surfaces render through it
# too, so a change there stays unclaimed and keeps selecting the whole family.
# ---- the menu-checkout fixture spec: it SKIPS unless MENU_FIXTURE_URL is set,
#      and its measurement is owned by `scripts/menu-fixture-e2e.sh` (the
#      `menufixture` gate). Mapping it to its own runner keeps it selected by a
#      change to that runner and never by an unrelated web change.
